title: One round of the five-module host
statement: Let $S,J,E,I$ be finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet, let $\mathrm{emit}$ and $\mathrm{next}$ map Boolean words to Boolean words, and let $B_E,B_I:\mathbb{N}\to\mathbb{N}$. Suppose $E$ satisfies the clean contract with result map the identity, emission map $\mathrm{emit}$, and budget $B_E$, and $I$ satisfies the clean contract with result map $\mathrm{next}$, empty emission, and budget $B_I$. For any Boolean input $x$ and body word $w$, the five-module host with $1+S.k+J.k+E.k+I.k$ work tapes, started at its loop anchor with the standard word assignment for $w$, reaches at some time $t$ with $0<t\le 1+B_E(|w|)+B_I(|w|)$ the loop-anchor configuration with the standard word assignment for $\mathrm{next}(w)$ and output $\mathrm{emit}(w)$; at every intermediate time $v$ with $0<v<t$, its control is not the loop anchor.
hypotheses_covered: $S,J,E,I$ are finite Turing machines over the Boolean alphabet
$\mathrm{emit}$ and $\mathrm{next}$ map Boolean words to Boolean words
$B_E,B_I$ are functions from natural numbers to natural numbers
$E$ satisfies the clean contract with identity result map, emission map $\mathrm{emit}$, and budget $B_E$
$I$ satisfies the clean contract with result map $\mathrm{next}$, empty emission, and budget $B_I$
replaced: Let the emission module satisfy the clean contract preserving its argument and emitting a chunk, and the update module the clean contract replacing the argument and emitting nothing. Then from the anchor over any body word $w$, the host first returns to the anchor at a positive time at most $1$ plus both budgets at $|w|$, having appended exactly the emitted chunk and replaced $w$ by its update; empty chunks and a stationary saturated cursor are covered.
